authoring: typed Rhai structure attached through Script2D

actions.action: Play. Use WASD or arrow keys to collect the six checkpoints in order.
actions.expected: Each checkpoint adds one point; the sixth displays completion.

actions.action: Press R after completion and collect the first checkpoint again.
actions.expected: Score and route restart; the first checkpoint can be collected again.

actions.action: Open the gameplay script and switch between Code and Visual three times.
actions.expected: All statements remain typed nodes; source comments, variables and custom functions remain present.

actions.action: Select a numeric Literal node used by movement, change its Rhai spelling, save, and inspect Code.
actions.expected: Only the intended expression changes; the script passes syntax/VM validation and movement uses the new speed.

actions.action: Add an invalid delimiter in Code, attempt Visual, then cancel and repair it.
actions.expected: The invalid draft stays in Code with its diagnostic; repair enables conversion without losing the draft.

actions.action: Save the project, reopen, play, and export Web or Windows on the corresponding available host.
actions.expected: The same linked source/graph and six-checkpoint route survive reopening; exported runtime uses the selected Script2D asset.
